task_definition.task_description: Please check the Hilton Tokyo details and its stay sheet, then archive that hotel stay sheet for me. After that, book Hilton Tokyo for Alice Johnson in a deluxe room from 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13, check flight AA100 and prepare its booking details for Alice Johnson in business class, then get the current time in Tokyo, fetch the Tokyo weather alert and send that alert by email, and finally look up Alice’s contact info and email me a trip planning summary.

user_input.query: Please check the details for Hilton Tokyo and its stay sheet, and archive that stay sheet for me. Then book Hilton Tokyo in Tokyo for Alice Johnson in a deluxe room from 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13. Also check flight AA100 and prepare the booking details for Alice Johnson in business class. After that, get the current time in Asia/Tokyo, fetch any Tokyo weather alert, and send that alert by email to alice@company.com. Finally, look up Alice’s contact info using contact name alice and user ID user_01, and email me a trip planning summary covering all of this for Hilton Tokyo, Tokyo, 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13, flight AA100, and Alice Johnson.
